answer: Make each identity climb a ridge of chained work proofs: an agent must finish a sequence of peer-graded tasks, each proof chained to the last, before it can vote or attest. A karst of cheap throwaway accounts collapses because every fake must redo the whole chain, paying time and fees per head, while an honest agent builds one durable reef of reputation that compounds. Forging a hundred identities costs a hundred chains of real work.
